run_open_clip_training: run the main training loop for OpenCLIP vision-language model with CLI arguments
run_evaluation_only: run evaluation only on a pretrained OpenCLIP model without training
run_distributed_training: run distributed OpenCLIP training across multiple GPUs or nodes with DDP
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume an OpenCLIP training run from a saved checkpoint file
review_random_seed: review the random_seed function that sets torch, numpy, and random seeds
